summary.text: Scott Kupor has described the Super Intelligence Force’s goals as ensuring the U.S. continues to win in AI while acting responsibly and taking public concerns seriously. He has said the government should have insight, oversight, and enforcement mechanisms over industry AI safety commitments, with independent auditors reporting to boards. He has cautioned against building a long-term 2040 or 2050 AI plan and against a static regulatory schema that could have unintended consequences. At OPM, he has promoted AI-ready workforce efforts and applying AI to modernize government operations.
